descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you an experienced Quantitative Developer? Do you enjoy innovative thinking? We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Developer to join our Equity Derivatives Quantitative Development (EMEA) team within UBS Global Markets.
• you will be working in a high performing, fast paced, and collaborative team that are responsible for the development and enhancement of the best-in-class Equity Derivatives platform, predominantly utilizing low latency Java
• the team sits within the Global Markets - Principal Flow Trading stream, and has a business reporting line
• you will take ownership of initiatives from initial analysis through to design, implementation and delivery
• you will proactively suggest and drive through improvements to the platform and our framework
• you will be involved in every aspect of algorithmic trading: - designing and building new quoting, execution and risk management flows - designing and building trader tools to help improve business workflows and efficiency - market connectivity - latency analysis and optimization - enhancing the proprietary eTrading framework that is used across the department
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you an experienced Quantitative Developer? Do you enjoy innovative thinking? We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Developer to join our Equity Derivatives Quantitative Development (EMEA) team within UBS Global Markets.
• design and deliver next-generation algorithmic trading solutions within the FX Options e-trading environment
• contribute directly to the Principal E-Trading business (covering FX, Precious Metals, Rates, Credit and Equities), building scalable and impactful trading functionality
• work as part of a high-performing quantitative development team, closely aligned with front-office business objectives
• develop and enhance systems that support electronic market making, with a strong focus on performance and reliability
• take ownership across the full software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through to implementation and production support
• collaborate closely with traders, quantitative analysts and global technology teams to deliver innovative trading capabilities
• drive improvements that have a measurable impact on revenue generation and business growth
